meta.title: DAY 1 — Octopuses have three hearts
meta.source: User script (verbatim). Facts: two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills, one systemic heart pumps it to the body; blood is blue from copper-based hemocyanin.

scenes.name: Hook

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This creature has THREE hearts. And that's not even the weirdest part!

spoken: This creature has three hearts. And that's not even the weirdest part!
scenes.note: Octopuses really do have three hearts

scenes.name: Gills and body

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two pump blood to its gills, while one pumps blood to the rest of its body.

scenes.note: Gill hearts → gills · systemic heart → body

scenes.name: Blue blood

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even crazier? Its blood is blue!

scenes.note: Blue from hemocyanin, a copper-based protein
